description: Gate 6: author and bake one bounded Glitter Pile through HDA_Foundry_Deposition, then integrate its static bulk and sparse active shell with the established Petal Niagara lifecycle and existing glitter material family.

loop_contract.static_bulk: Bake the resting pile once as SM_GlitterPile_Rest plus accumulation/sparkle/flow fields. The 200000 source grains are not runtime Niagara particles.

active_shell.lifecycle: Use one bounded long-lived pile loop: seeded active grains may lift, flutter, and return to their baked rest positions; recycle or kill/respawn within the same finite set so cycles never accumulate particles.
active_shell.loop_phase: Deterministic seed and normalized looping phase; verify at least three cycles, pause/resume, and restart against the same baked pile.

material_loop.rule: Use the Petal assets as loop/lifecycle references only. Keep glitter on an existing glitter master and its instances; do not assign petal cards or atlas materials to the grains or make a new material master.

loop_contract.beat_response: Use an existing Niagara user parameter or established BeatPulse route only when the selected owner already supplies it. Do not add an MPC writer or audio bridge for this effect.

outputs.name: glitter_active_points.csv
outputs.note: unstable/shell grains only (<= 5k) for Niagara spawn

outputs.name: glitter_density.vdb
outputs.note: low-res density volume; never commit large sequences

ue_target.note: Static bulk = baked mesh/texture. NS_GlitterPileLoop owns only the <=5000 active shell, with one ActiveShellLoop emitter; MI_GlitterPileLoop defaults to M_Glitter_Enhanced_Master. Use existing Petal loop/settle behavior as the lifecycle reference and NS_Morning_GlitterGlint as a separate glint accent. These are one bounded project effect and instance, not a second framework or master.
